name: Drill
description: For skills you train, not facts you memorize: typing speed, scales, mental math. The card comes back every day (or every few days), as many times as you set, and every result is kept so you can watch it improve.

options.name: perDay
options.label: Times per day
options.description: How many runs a practice day asks for. After that the card waits for the next practice day. 0: no limit, it stays available.

options.name: everyDays
options.label: Practice every
options.description: 1 is every day, 2 every other day.
